title: Worst app for realibility
body:
When You want to store Your thoughts, Your notes, Your brainstorming ideas - DO NOT CHOOSE this app. 
I was storing for almost a year my notes in Google Keep. And now - the app has deleted the latest entries in my account. 
Couple of days work has disappeared without a trace. 
Thank You, unreliable Google. 
Now I will try to download and transfer all my notes to some different app which I can trust - which will not accidently start to put checklists to all recents notes. And after re-openening the app - these notes have been deleted by the app itself. 
“Thank You”. 
And for FUTURE DOWNLOADERS - do not try this. Maybe it looks “cool” and “flashy colors are attractive”. Also - that You can make notes with an ease. 
But the reliablility - (that Your notes will always be stored in the cloud) - definitely 0%. Do not trust.
